porcentaje_plataforma.ayuda: The rest goes to the caregiver

porcentaje_iva.ayuda: Only applies to the commission, not the caregiver's money

plazo_pago_horas.ayuda: From when the walk ends; reminders are sent afterwards

bloqueo_tras_horas.ayuda: Without paying, the tutor cannot request new walks

monto_minimo.ayuda: If not reached, it moves to the following week

ventana_reclamo_horas.ayuda: Time the tutor has to dispute a charge closed by the team

cierre_automatico_horas.ayuda: Closes the unconfirmed handoff on its own, from when the caregiver finishes

iva_aplica.label: Charge VAT on the commission
iva_aplica.desc: If Paw-Path is responsible for VAT

iva_incluido.label: VAT included in the price
iva_incluido.desc: If turned off, VAT is added to the price the tutor pays

solo_recaudadas.label: Settle only walks already paid by the tutor
solo_recaudadas.desc: If turned off, Paw-Path pays the caregiver even if the tutor has not paid

documento_soporte.label: Supporting document when paying caregivers
documento_soporte.desc: For caregivers not required to invoice (DIAN)

cobrar_si_cierra_equipo.label: The team can close an unconfirmed handoff and charge
cobrar_si_cierra_equipo.desc: If the tutor does not confirm, the team closes in favor of the caregiver and the charge is generated (the tutor can dispute it)

cierre_requiere_evidencia.label: Automatic closing requires evidence
cierre_requiere_evidencia.desc: Group photo uploaded by the caregiver

vista_previa.linea_one: {{count}} pet: tutor pays {{tutor}} · caregiver receives {{cuidador}} · Paw-Path {{comision}} + VAT {{iva}}
vista_previa.linea_other: {{count}} pets: tutor pays {{tutor}} · caregiver receives {{cuidador}} · Paw-Path {{comision}} + VAT {{iva}}

politica.publicada_desc: Commercial policy v{{version}} is in force from now on.
politica.sin_cambios_desc: The values are the same as the current version; no version was created.

resumen.solo_pagado: Settle only what is already paid
resumen.cierre_equipo: Team can close unconfirmed handoff and charge

liquidaciones.ninguna: There are no payments ready to settle (or they do not reach the minimum amount)
liquidaciones.vacio: There are no settlements to pay

entregas.motivo_placeholder: Reason for the decision (it is recorded)
entregas.vacio: There are no handoffs to review
entregas.cerrar_a_favor: Close in favor of the caregiver

documentos.vacio_lectura: There are no accounting documents yet
documentos.vacio: All documents are reflected in the accounting system

max_mascotas.descripcion: Pet limit in a single walk (shared walks too). Each caregiver can choose to work with fewer, never more

escalada_minutos.descripcion: If the chosen caregiver does not respond, the request is opened to other caregivers

foto_entrega_obligatoria.descripcion: Requires the caregiver to upload the group photo to finish the walk

entrega_aviso_horas.descripcion: Hours from when the caregiver finishes the walk until the tutor is reminded to confirm the handoff (chat message)

entrega_revision_horas.descripcion: Hours from when the caregiver finishes the walk until, if the tutor has not confirmed the handoff, it goes to the team queue

servicio_desde_min.descripcion: Earliest time a walk can start and a caregiver can declare their schedule, in minutes from midnight, Colombia time (330 = 5:30 a.m.)

servicio_hasta_min.descripcion: Time by which the last walk of the day must end, in minutes from midnight, Colombia time (1350 = 10:30 p.m.)

margen_horario_min.descripcion: Courtesy minutes: a walk that starts a little earlier or ends a little later than the declared schedule is still considered within it

antelacion_min.descripcion: Minutes that must remain before the start of a walk today for it to be requested or accepted

descanso_entre_paseos_min.descripcion: Free minutes a caregiver needs between the end of one walk and the start of the next

exigir_zona.descripcion: If active, services can only be requested (and caregivers only receive requests) in active or pilot zones. Anyone trying outside is recorded as interested. Leave it off until the first zone is defined

otp_minutos_expiracion.descripcion: Minutes during which the sent code is valid

otp_segundos_reenvio.descripcion: Seconds between code sends (prevents abuse and costs)

otp_max_intentos.descripcion: Failed attempts before the code is blocked

dias_revelacion.descripcion: An evaluation without a counterpart is revealed on one of these days, at random (the evaluated person does not know when)

min_datos_indices.titulo: Minimum data to show the indices
min_datos_indices.descripcion: Moments and incidents a zone needs before showing its wellbeing, safety, activity and socialization. With fewer, “not enough data” is shown: one or two records do not represent the place

paseo_compartido.descripcion: Allows choosing shared walks when booking

cobertura_manual.descripcion: Lets caregivers pick on the map the cells where they work, instead of only a radius around their home. When turned off, everyone goes back to their radius (manual picks are kept and apply again if turned back on)

dias_vigencia_aprendizaje.descripcion: A learning about the pet ("gets nervous around motorbikes") stops showing in the summary if it is not seen again within these days. It is not deleted.

repeticiones_para_firme.titulo: Times to consider a learning firm
repeticiones_para_firme.descripcion: Times a learning must be observed (or seen by 2 different caregivers) to go from "observed" to "firm"

aprendizajes_en_resumen.titulo: Learnings per section in the pre-walk summary
aprendizajes_en_resumen.descripcion: Maximum learnings the caregiver sees before the walk in each section (what works, what to avoid, keep in mind)

priorizar_conocidos.titulo: Prioritize caregivers who already know the pet
priorizar_conocidos.descripcion: When choosing a caregiver, those who have already walked the pet appear first with their number of walks

antecedentes_vigencia_meses.descripcion: Months the criminal background certificate is valid from approval; when it expires, the caregiver must renew it. It does not change those already approved

peso_continuidad.descripcion: How much a caregiver who already walked the order's pets moves up the list (applies only if "Prioritize caregivers who already know the pet" is active)

peso_calificacion.descripcion: How much the caregiver's rating weighs (smoothed: with few walks it weighs less)

peso_cercania.descripcion: How much it weighs that the caregiver lives near the tutor

paseos_para_confiar.descripcion: With fewer walks than this, the rating is blended with an initial one and the caregiver is shown as "new"

penalizacion_por_aviso.descripcion: How much a caregiver drops in the list when the order does not fully fit them (a size they do not usually care for, more dogs than they prefer). It does not hide them: the tutor is warned and the caregiver decides

max_resultados.descripcion: Maximum caregivers returned to the tutor when choosing

configuracion.actualizado: Updated: {{lista}}. It applies everywhere in less than a minute.

motivo.ayuda: It is recorded in the version history

versiones.reactivada_desc: The content of v{{version}} is now in force as v{{nueva}}.
versiones.ya_vigente: That content is already the current one.
versiones.vacio: There are no published versions yet.

consentimientos.publicada_desc: {{tipo}} v{{version}} is in force. Those who accepted the previous one will have to reconfirm.
consentimientos.sin_cambios_desc: The content is the same as the current one; no version was created.
consentimientos.obligatorio_desc: The app cannot be used without accepting it

zonas.sin_servicio_titulo: They ask for service and we have not arrived yet
zonas.sin_servicio_detalle: {{tutores}} to request a walk and {{cuidadores}} in {{celdas}} outside the service area. They show in purple on the Territory map.
zonas.vacio: There are no zones yet. Create the first one by painting the neighborhoods you want to serve.
zonas.resumen: {{demanda}} pending requests · {{paseos}} walks in progress · average coverage {{cobertura}}
zonas.sin_cobertura_one: {{count}} cell with requests and no caregivers
zonas.sin_cobertura_other: {{count}} cells with requests and no caregivers

editor.faltan_datos_desc: Enter the name, the city and the reason for the change.
editor.subtitulo: Tap the hexagons to add them to the zone

mapa.ya_es_de: This cell already belongs to the zone "{nombre}"
mapa.solo_excluir_dentro: You can only exclude within what the zone already covers
mapa.acerca: Zoom in to see the cells of this scale

vacio.EN_REVISION: There are no approvals waiting for review.
vacio.BORRADOR: Nobody has an approval in draft.
vacio.APROBADA: There are no approved approvals yet.

tarjeta.lo_comprueba_sistema: The system checks it on submission.
tarjeta.proveedor: Validated by the provider ({{proveedor}}): its response will arrive.
tarjeta.motivo_placeholder: E.g.: the photo is blurry, retake it in good light
